how.title: Get the full picture in two minutes.
how.s2d: Upload a CSV from openrouter.ai/activity, or connect an Admin API key.
how.s3d: See which models and apps cost the most, and where to save.

items.a: OpenRouter (CSV import and API sync), Anthropic and OpenAI (via their Admin Usage APIs). You'll see Gemini, Mistral, Groq or Grok models if you call them through OpenRouter. Direct connections to other providers aren't available yet.

items.q: How do I upload an OpenRouter CSV?
items.a: On openrouter.ai open Activity and choose Export → CSV. Then drop the file onto the dashboard. Re-uploading is fine — duplicates are skipped by request ID.

items.q: How do you convert dollars to crowns?
items.a: Providers bill in USD. Tokeny fetches the official Czech National Bank rate once a day. Switch currency with a single tap.

Data lives in Supabase Postgres and every row is tied to your account with Row-Level Security policies. Provider API keys are encrypted at rest in Supabase Vault and never sent back to the browser (you only see the last 4 characters). You can delete your account and all data at any time from your profile.

The core dashboard is free. The Pro plan (99 CZK per month or 990 CZK per year) adds daily automatic sync, a monthly budget with in-app alerts (total and per provider), a month-end spend forecast, exports, sharing and the MCP server. The AI assistant is in both plans and runs on your own API key (Anthropic, OpenAI or OpenRouter), so you pay that provider directly for its tokens; Tokeny charges nothing for them. The free plan stays.
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI clients such as Claude, Cursor or Grok Bot read your stats. Generate a token in Settings, paste it into your client config and ask right in the chat.

items.q: How do I connect Tokeny to Grok Bot?
items.a: Create a token in Settings → MCP server (Pro). In Grok Bot, ask a bot to add a custom MCP server with the URL shown in Settings and the header Authorization: Bearer <token>; enter the token in the masked secret field. Then type @tokeny in the chat and ask about your spend. It works the same way as Cursor or Claude.

items.q: What happens to my Pro subscription if I delete my account?
items.a: Deleting your account cancels Pro in Stripe immediately, so you won't be charged again. The rest of the paid period is not refunded automatically. Invoices stay with Stripe as accounting law requires. To cancel Pro but keep your account, use subscription management in Settings.

grok.note: Use the header, not OAuth sign-in – Tokeny doesn't issue tokens via OAuth. MCP is part of Pro.

budget.method: Weighted average daily spend over the last {{n}} full days (recent days weigh more, 7-day half-life) × days left ({{remaining}}) + what is already spent. The ~80% range comes from how much daily spend varies; fewer days make it wider. Days are UTC, data is from the last sync.
budget.methodNone: The forecast needs at least one full day of data. Until then we only show what is spent.

budget.under: At this pace about {{amount}} of the budget will be left.
